title: Grateful Dead Live at The Centrum on 1988-04-07
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6MHz) > Tascam Hi-Res Editor (WAV 24-bit/96k) > Samplitude Pro X6 Suite > FLAC/24
taper: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy
source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-R90)

ai_review.summary: Phenomenal ultramatrix sound and a hot, vocal‑rich performance with standout Row Jimmy and BRRB moments.
ai_review.review: The ultramatrix recording is described as phenomenal, delivering crystal‑clear vocals and overall superb clarity. The show itself is praised as "hot" with memorable performances of the Row Jimmy segment and the BRRB jam, making it a highly enjoyable listening experience despite the lack of detailed set information.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review (4 stars) but it is uniformly enthusiastic about both sound quality and performance, suggesting a rating just above the given star level.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Phenomenal clarity; vocals stand out; overall crisp and balanced ultramatrix mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic and hot throughout, with strong momentum carried by the highlighted jams.
